eligibility.text: First-year Post-SSC Diploma in Engineering/Technology: candidate must meet the Maharashtra DTE eligibility conditions for the 2026-27 diploma admission cycle, including passing the prescribed SSC/10th qualification from a recognized institution and satisfying the applicable candidature/subject requirements.
eligibility.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

steps.text: Register online on the Maharashtra DTE diploma admission portal, fill the application, upload/submit the required documents, complete document scrutiny/confirmation, participate in CAP rounds, and report to the allotted institute for admission formalities.
steps.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admissions 2026-27

documents.text: SSC/10th or qualifying marksheet; school/college leaving certificate; nationality/domicile documents as applicable; category/caste/income/non-creamy-layer/caste-validity documents where applicable; gap certificate if applicable; equivalence or migration certificate for applicable outside-Maharashtra qualifications; passport-size photographs and required copies.
documents.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

dates.text: For AY 2026-27, DTE states that First Year Engineering/Architecture Diploma admissions commenced on 20 May 2026. CAP and institute-level vacancy schedules are issued separately by DTE.
dates.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – official notices, 2026-27

eligibility.text: For Direct Second Year of Post-SSC Diploma Courses, DTE 2026-27 permits eligible 10+2/HSC candidates with a qualifying subject combination listed in the brochure; the candidate must satisfy the applicable Maharashtra candidature requirements.
eligibility.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

steps.text: Apply through the Maharashtra DTE Direct Second Year Diploma admission process, complete document scrutiny/confirmation, participate in the applicable CAP process, and report to the allotted institute.
steps.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admissions 2026-27

documents.text: SSC/10th or qualifying marksheet; school/college leaving certificate; nationality/domicile documents as applicable; category/caste/income/non-creamy-layer/caste-validity documents where applicable; gap certificate if applicable; equivalence or migration certificate for applicable outside-Maharashtra qualifications; passport-size photographs and required copies. For Direct Second Year, include the qualifying HSC/10+2 marksheet as applicable.
documents.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

dates.text: Direct Second Year Diploma admission dates are released through the DTE Maharashtra CAP schedule for the relevant academic year; use the current DTE schedule for exact round dates.
dates.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – official notices, 2026-27

eligibility.text: Direct Second Year Diploma eligibility includes 10th/SSC plus a qualifying two-year ITI with appropriate specialization, subject to Maharashtra DTE rules for 2026-27.
eligibility.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

steps.text: Register for the DTE Direct Second Year Diploma admission process, complete document verification/confirmation, participate in CAP, and complete institute reporting and admission formalities after allotment.
steps.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admissions 2026-27

documents.text: SSC/10th or qualifying marksheet; school/college leaving certificate; nationality/domicile documents as applicable; category/caste/income/non-creamy-layer/caste-validity documents where applicable; gap certificate if applicable; equivalence or migration certificate for applicable outside-Maharashtra qualifications; passport-size photographs and required copies. For Direct Second Year through ITI, include the SSC/10th certificate and the qualifying ITI certificate/marksheet.
documents.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – Diploma Admission Information Brochure 2026-27

dates.text: Direct Second Year Diploma dates are published by DTE Maharashtra in the annual CAP schedule; exact dates vary by the admission cycle and round.
dates.source: Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra State – official notices, 2026-27

facilities.text: Available records report a library reading hall capacity of 150, library networking and multimedia/reprographic facilities, with reported library holdings of 4,134 titles and 20,974 volumes plus 16 national journals in the historical institute record. Departmental records also report dedicated laboratories/workshops for Civil, Computer, Electrical/Power, Electronics & Telecommunication and Mechanical Engineering. Because these detailed facility figures come from older public institute records, current availability should be confirmed with the institute.
facilities.source: Public B.L. Patil Polytechnic institute record (historical facility data); DTE institute records
facilities.updated: Historical facility data; current existence not independently re-verified
